description: Change a video's title, description, visibility (public/private), player colour or content category, its Earn settings (ads on or off, ad formats, offered to advertisers), or make its adaptive quality versions. Only the fields given are changed. Nothing here deletes a video: its owner deletes it on its own page (urls.manage); offer private, which hides it from everyone else and can be undone.

ad_formats.description: Which ad formats may show on this video: banner, overlay, pause, end_screen, pre_roll; [] = none; null = the account's default (Earn page).

ads_enabled.description: Whether ads may show on this video (the video page's Earn switch).

category.description: Content category used for ad targeting; null clears it.

make_quality_versions.description: Make this video's adaptive quality versions now (the video page's button; included with a paid plan).

anyOf.description: Player accent colour as a 6-digit hex value, e.g. #22d3ee.

player_color.description: Player accent colour; null returns to your brand default.

video_id.description: The video's public id (from list_videos / get_video).

visibility.description: Who can watch: public (anyone with the link / embed) or private (only you).

name: update_video
title: Update video
